_about: Season-end career lines from the market history (scripts/career_seasons.py). Row = [ovr, skill, legacy, value, grade, ...fields[group], sovr] at the end of each season from `from`; null = not in that season's snapshot. sovr = his SEASON OVR that season (scripts/season_ovr.py; null = no line: first season or no games); ovr is the career card rating. A season's own line is the change between two consecutive rows.
